name: rentemester-bank-reconciliation-account-role-fallback-v35
sql:
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS bank_reconciliation_correction_events_guard_insert;
CREATE TRIGGER bank_reconciliation_correction_events_guard_insert BEFORE INSERT ON bank_reconciliation_correction_events WHEN NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id = NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions bt LEFT JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.id=bt.bank_account_id WHERE bt.id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND COALESCE(ba.ledger_account_no,(SELECT m.account_no FROM account_role_mappings m WHERE m.role='bank' AND m.status='confirmed' ORDER BY m.version DESC LIMIT 1))=NEW.bank_account_no AND CAST(ROUND(100 * CASE WHEN UPPER(bt.currency)='DKK' THEN bt.amount ELSE bt.amount_dkk END) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND je.status='posted' AND je.reversal_of_entry_id IS NULL AND je.source_bank_transaction_id IS NULL AND je.entry_hash=NEW.replacement_journal_hash) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries reversal WHERE reversal.reversal_of_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries direct WHERE direct.id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND direct.source_bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events replacement WHERE replacement.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines jl JOIN accounts a ON a.id=jl.account_id WHERE jl.journal_entry_id=NEW.replacement_journal_entry_id AND a.account_no=NEW.bank_account_no GROUP BY jl.journal_entry_id HAVING CAST(ROUND(100 * SUM(jl.debit_amount-jl.credit_amount)) AS INTEGER)=CAST(ROUND(100 * NEW.bank_amount_dkk) AS INTEGER)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='direct' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries je WHERE je.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND je.id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id AND je.source_bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='append-only' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_journal_reconciliation_links link WHERE link.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND link.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND link.journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) OR (NEW.supersedes_kind='correction' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bank_reconciliation_correction_events event WHERE event.id=NEW.supersedes_id AND event.bank_transaction_id=NEW.bank_transaction_id AND event.replacement_journal_entry_id=NEW.superseded_journal_entry_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'bank reconciliation correction must supersede one same-bank current target with an exact eligible replacement'); END;
